Availability and correctness answer different questions.

/healthz confirms that the process can answer HTTP. A successful development snapshot confirms a database read at a point in time. Neither demonstrates transaction correctness. The Go integration tests independently inspect committed state after retries, competition and deliberately failed transactions.

This application has no production authentication. Keep it local. A guild selector changes request input; it is not an authorization boundary.
